# SITSAR

## Information Theory, Geometry and Statistics for Synthetic Aperture Radar Data

**SITSAR** brings together statistical models, information-theoretic
measures and image-analysis tools for **Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR)**
and **polarimetric SAR (PolSAR)** data. It gathers the methods developed
in the master’s dissertation (*divergence-based classifiers*) and in the
PhD thesis (*Shannon entropies, entropy-based segmentation and change
detection, and compound Wishart models*) of Jodavid A. Ferreira,
supervised by Abraão D. C. Nascimento (UFPE, Brazil).

The main tools are **R6 classes**, and the classifiers are available as
a **[parsnip](https://parsnip.tidymodels.org/) model**, so they work
inside **[tidymodels](https://www.tidymodels.org/)** workflows (recipes,
resampling, tuning and yardstick metrics).

| Topic | Tools |
|:---|:---|
| Intensity models | [`dg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)/[`pg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)/[`qg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)/[`rg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md), `*gammasar()`, `*ggamma()` |
| Matrix (PolSAR) models | [`dwishart_sar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dwishart_sar.md), [`dg0p()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0p.md), [`dctpcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md), [`dcgcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md) and generators |
| R6 models (ML/EM estimation, entropy, variance) | `GammaSAR`, `G0I`, `GGammaSAR`, `WishartSAR`, `G0Polarimetric`, `CompoundWishart` |
| Shannon entropies | [`entropy_gamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md), [`entropy_g0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md), [`entropy_ggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md), [`entropy_wishart()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md), [`entropy_g0p()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md) |
| Images | `SARImage`, [`sar_features()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/sar_features.md), [`entropy_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy_map.md), [`plot_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/plot_map.md) |
| Segmentation | `EntropySegmenter` (EM / SEM), [`segment_sar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/segment_sar.md) |
| Hypothesis tests and change detection | [`entropy_test()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy_test.md), [`change_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/change_map.md), [`change_detection_metrics()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/change_detection_metrics.md) |
| Divergences and classification | [`divergence_gaussian()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergences.md), [`divergence_wishart()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergences.md), [`distancesg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/distancesg0i.md), `DivergenceClassifier`, [`divergence_classifier()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergence_classifier.md) |
| Accuracy | [`kappa_statistics()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/kappa_statistics.md) |

## Installation

``` r

# From CRAN
install.packages("SITSAR")

# Development version from GitHub
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("jodavid/SITSAR")
```

## A PolSAR image

The package ships a 150 x 150 crop of the L-band AIRSAR image of San
Francisco (`SanFrancisco150`) and its ground truth
(`SanFrancisco150_gt`).

``` r

library(SITSAR)

img <- SARImage$new(SanFrancisco150, looks = 4)
img
#> <SARImage> 150 x 150 PolSAR (3 x 3 covariance)
#>   channels: HH, HV, VV
#>   looks: 4
#>   mean HH  = 0.1735
#>   mean HV  = 0.04224
#>   mean VV  = 0.147

op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
img$plot()
plot_map(SanFrancisco150_gt, main = "Ground truth",
         palette = c("#1f78b4", "#33a02c", "#e31a1c"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-image-1.png)

``` r

par(op)
```

## Models, estimation and Shannon entropy

``` r

set.seed(1)
x <- rg0i(1000, alpha = -3, gamma = 2, L = 4)

fit <- G0I$new()$fit(x)        # maximum likelihood (alpha, gamma and L)
fit
#> <G0I> fitted to n = 1000 observations
#>   alpha = -3.95788
#>   gamma = 2.80374
#>   L = 3.00607
#>   logLik = -835.636
#>   Shannon entropy = 0.835636
fit$entropy_variance()         # asymptotic variance of the entropy estimator
#> [1] 0.001158187
generics::tidy(fit)
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   term  estimate std.error fixed
#>   <chr>    <dbl>     <dbl> <lgl>
#> 1 alpha    -3.96     0.531 FALSE
#> 2 gamma     2.80     0.469 FALSE
#> 3 L         3.01     0.311 FALSE

# Polarimetric models
Sigma <- polsar_example_sigma("forest")
Z <- rg0p(500, alpha = -4, Sigma = Sigma, L = 4)
G0Polarimetric$new()$fit(Z, L = 4)$params$alpha
#> [1] -4.028688
```

## Entropy maps and unsupervised segmentation

``` r

H <- entropy_map(img, model = "wishart", window = 7, L = 4)

set.seed(2)
seg <- EntropySegmenter$new(k = 3, method = "em")$fit(H)

op <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
plot_map(H, main = "Wishart entropy map")
plot_map(seg$label_map(), main = "Entropy-based segmentation",
         palette = c("#1f78b4", "#33a02c", "#e31a1c"))
```

![](reference/figures/README-segmentation-1.png)

``` r

par(op)

kappa_statistics(SanFrancisco150_gt, seg$label_map(), match = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 5
#>   kappa   variance std_error overall_accuracy     n
#>   <dbl>      <dbl>     <dbl>            <dbl> <dbl>
#> 1 0.914 0.00000566   0.00238            0.945 22500
```

## Divergence-based classification with tidymodels

``` r

library(parsnip)
library(workflows)
library(recipes)
library(yardstick)

feats <- sar_features(img, window = 5)
feats$class <- factor(as.vector(SanFrancisco150_gt),
                      labels = c("ocean", "vegetation", "urban"))
set.seed(3)
train <- feats[sample(nrow(feats), 450), ]

spec <- divergence_classifier(divergence = "renyi", order = 0.9) |>
  set_engine("wishart")

rec <- recipe(class ~ ., data = train) |>
  update_role(row, col, new_role = "id")

wf_fit <- workflow(rec, spec) |> fit(data = train)

pred <- augment(wf_fit, feats)
accuracy(pred, truth = class, estimate = .pred_class)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 3
#>   .metric  .estimator .estimate
#>   <chr>    <chr>          <dbl>
#> 1 accuracy multiclass     0.952
```

## Entropy-based change detection

``` r

set.seed(4)
before <- matrix(rgammasar(60 * 60, mu = 1, L = 4), 60)
after <- before
after[21:40, 21:45] <- rgammasar(500, mu = 3, L = 4)

cd <- change_map(before, after, model = "gamma", window = 5, L = 4)
cd
#> <Entropy-based change map> model: gamma | level: 0.01 
#>   size: 60 x 60 
#>   changed pixels: 611 (16.97%)
plot_map(cd$change, main = "Detected changes")
```

![](reference/figures/README-change-1.png)

## References

- Ferreira, J. A., Coêlho, H. and Nascimento, A. D. C. (2021). A family
  of divergence-based classifiers for Polarimetric Synthetic Aperture
  Radar (PolSAR) imagery vector and matrix features. *International
  Journal of Remote Sensing*, 42(4), 1201–1229.
  [doi:10.1080/01431161.2020.1826060](https://doi.org/10.1080/01431161.2020.1826060)
- Ferreira, J. A. and Nascimento, A. D. C. (2020). Shannon entropy for
  the G_(I)⁰ model: a new segmentation approach. *IEEE JSTARS*, 13,
  2547–2553.
  [doi:10.1109/JSTARS.2020.2997666](https://doi.org/10.1109/JSTARS.2020.2997666)
- Ferreira, J. A., Nascimento, A. D. C. and Frery, A. C. (2022). PolSAR
  models with multimodal intensities. *Remote Sensing*, 14(20), 5083.
  [doi:10.3390/rs14205083](https://doi.org/10.3390/rs14205083)
- Nascimento, A. D. C., Ferreira, J. A. and Frery, A. C. (2023).
  Unsupervised segmentation of PolSAR data with complex Wishart and G0m
  distributions and Shannon entropy. *Statistics and Computing*,
  33, 129.
  [doi:10.1007/s11222-023-10298-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s11222-023-10298-0)
- Ferreira, J. A. (2017). *Classificadores induzidos de divergências
  para modelos vetoriais e para distribuição Wishart complexa:
  experimentos em imagens PolSAR*. Master’s dissertation, UFPE.
- Ferreira, J. A. (2021). *Entropias e somas compostas para matrizes
  estocásticas aplicadas a sistemas PolSAR*. PhD thesis, UFPE.

# Package index

## Package overview

- [`SITSAR`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SITSAR-package.md)
  [`SITSAR-package`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SITSAR-package.md)
  : SITSAR: Information Theory, Geometry and Statistics for SAR Data

## Intensity distributions

Univariate models for SAR intensities.

- [`dg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)
  [`pg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)
  [`qg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md)
  [`rg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0i.md) : The
  G0I distribution for SAR intensities
- [`dgammasar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dgammasar.md)
  [`pgammasar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dgammasar.md)
  [`qgammasar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dgammasar.md)
  [`rgammasar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dgammasar.md)
  : The Gamma distribution for SAR intensities
- [`dggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dggamma.md)
  [`pggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dggamma.md)
  [`qggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dggamma.md)
  [`rggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dggamma.md) :
  The generalized Gamma distribution for SAR intensities

## Matrix (PolSAR) distributions

Models for Hermitian positive definite PolSAR matrices.

- [`dwishart_sar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dwishart_sar.md)
  [`rwishart_sar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dwishart_sar.md)
  : The scaled complex Wishart distribution
- [`dg0p()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0p.md)
  [`rg0p()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/dg0p.md) : The
  G0 polarimetric distribution
- [`dctpcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md)
  [`rctpcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md)
  [`dcgcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md)
  [`rcgcw()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/compound_wishart.md)
  : Compound complex Wishart distributions
- [`as_polsar_array()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/polsar-format.md)
  [`as_polsar_vec()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/polsar-format.md)
  : Convert between PolSAR storage formats
- [`polsar_example_sigma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/polsar_example_sigma.md)
  : Example PolSAR covariance matrices

## R6 statistical models

Estimation, Shannon entropy and asymptotic variances.

- [`SARModel`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SARModel.md) :
  Base R6 class for SAR and PolSAR statistical models
- [`GammaSAR`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/GammaSAR.md) :
  Gamma model for SAR intensities (R6)
- [`G0I`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/G0I.md) : G0I model
  for SAR intensities (R6)
- [`GGammaSAR`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/GGammaSAR.md)
  : Generalized Gamma model for SAR intensities (R6)
- [`WishartSAR`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/WishartSAR.md)
  : Scaled complex Wishart model for PolSAR data (R6)
- [`G0Polarimetric`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/G0Polarimetric.md)
  : G0 polarimetric model for PolSAR data (R6)
- [`CompoundWishart`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/CompoundWishart.md)
  : Compound complex Wishart models (R6)
- [`tidy(`*`<SARModel>`*`)`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/sarmodel-methods.md)
  [`glance(`*`<SARModel>`*`)`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/sarmodel-methods.md)
  [`logLik(`*`<SARModel>`*`)`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/sarmodel-methods.md)
  : Tidy and glance methods for SITSAR models
- [`g0iestimation()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/g0iestimation.md)
  : Estimation of G0I parameters

## Shannon entropy

- [`entropy_gamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md)
  [`entropy_g0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md)
  [`entropy_ggamma()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md)
  [`entropy_wishart()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md)
  [`entropy_g0p()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy.md)
  : Shannon entropies of SAR and PolSAR models
- [`entropy_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy_map.md)
  : Shannon entropy maps
- [`entropy_test()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/entropy_test.md)
  : Entropy-based test for two SAR samples

## Images

- [`SARImage`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SARImage.md) :
  SAR and PolSAR images (R6)
- [`sar_features()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/sar_features.md)
  : Local features of SAR images for pixel classification
- [`plot_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/plot_map.md)
  : Plot a map

## Segmentation and change detection

- [`EntropySegmenter`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/EntropySegmenter.md)
  : Entropy-based segmentation by (stochastic) EM (R6)
- [`segment_sar()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/segment_sar.md)
  : Entropy-based segmentation of a SAR/PolSAR image
- [`change_map()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/change_map.md)
  : Entropy-based change detection between two images

## Divergences and classification

- [`divergence_gaussian()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergences.md)
  [`divergence_wishart()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergences.md)
  : Divergences between Gaussian and complex Wishart models
- [`distancesg0i()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/distancesg0i.md)
  : Stochastic distances between G0I distributions
- [`distancesg0itable()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/distancesg0itable.md)
  : Table of G0I stochastic distances between two image regions
- [`DivergenceClassifier`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/DivergenceClassifier.md)
  : Divergence-based classifier for SAR/PolSAR features (R6)
- [`divergence_classifier()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergence_classifier.md)
  [`update(`*`<divergence_classifier>`*`)`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/divergence_classifier.md)
  : Divergence-based classifier as a 'parsnip' model
- [`renyi_order()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/renyi_order.md)
  [`divergence_type()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/renyi_order.md)
  [`renyi_kind()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/renyi_order.md)
  : Tuning parameters for the divergence classifier

## Accuracy assessment

- [`kappa_statistics()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/kappa_statistics.md)
  : Kappa coefficient and overall accuracy
- [`change_detection_metrics()`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/change_detection_metrics.md)
  : Accuracy measures for change detection

## Datasets

- [`SanFrancisco150`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SanFrancisco150.md)
  : San Francisco PolSAR image (150 x 150 pixels)
- [`SanFrancisco150_gt`](https://jodavid.github.io/SITSAR/reference/SanFrancisco150_gt.md)
  : Ground truth of the San Francisco image
